---
title: 'skillpouch unlink'
description: 'Stop syncing one assistant, or this whole computer. Every file stays, as a real file instead of a link'
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli.mjs from `skillpouch --help`. Do not edit; run `pnpm --filter @skillpouch/docs gen:cli`. -->

```text
Stop syncing one assistant, or this whole computer. Every file stays, as a real file instead of a link

Usage: skillpouch unlink [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --assistant <ID>  Only this assistant (`claude-code`, `codex`, …)
  -h, --help            Print help
  -V, --version         Print version
```

Without `--assistant`, the whole computer stops syncing; your pouch stays on the server, and running `skillpouch` sets the computer up again. Link an assistant again with `skillpouch select --on <id>`.

_Generated from `skillpouch 0.2.2`._
